$comment: Take over and hand back on an agent's cloud computer, shared by the web (src/lib/agents/computer-handback.ts) and the apps (native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoWorkKit/Agents/NativeComputerHandBack.swift). Both read or assert against this file; tests/agents-computer-handback.test.ts and NativeComputerHandBackTests.swift fail when either drifts. Placeholders: {agent} is the agent's name, {product} the product name, {rest} the rest-time phrase, {summary} what the agent is doing.
handBackAnswer: Done. I've finished on your computer; continue.

stateSentences.asleep: Asleep. It wakes when {agent} starts working.
stateSentences.awake: Idle. It rests after {rest} of quiet.

takeoverSentences.mine: You have control. {agent} waits until you hand back.
takeoverSentences.web: Your browser has control right now.
takeoverSentences.iphone: Your iPhone has control right now.
takeoverSentences.ipad: Your iPad has control right now.
takeoverSentences.mac: Your Mac has control right now.
takeoverSentences.app: Another device has control right now.
